meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and when?
The checker says 94 percent.

A machine's guess, and that wasn't my question. The company that sells these tools says their score should never be the sole basis for punishing a student; I have their guide printed in my bag. Who decided, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
It's very reliable.
"Very reliable." Independent studies say these detectors are neither accurate nor reliable, and you still haven't told me who decided.
I just have a feeling about it.
"A feeling." You put a zero in the gradebook on a feeling and software, and nobody called me first. I'll be in the principal's office today unless you have a document.
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Then show me what you have on paper.
We're on the same team here.
We're not. Who entered the zero, and on what basis?
I really think he used something.

You "really think." That's my son you're accusing, on nothing but a hunch and a machine, and Owen told me he wrote it himself. Show me something with a date on it, or this goes to the principal tonight.
Kids these days, you know?
I don't know, and neither do you. Owen's essay, not kids these days.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.
I've been doing this for twenty, and in my world "I can tell" loses. You called me in here with nothing.
The writing doesn't sound like him.
Compared to what? Put it on the table.
He seemed nervous when I asked.
A seventeen-year-old was nervous when his teacher accused him, so he's guilty? Did you ask him before you entered the zero, or after? Ten minutes.
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
That's not Owen's problem. Before or after?
Can we just find a middle ground?
On what? You haven't shown me a single page. The zero comes off, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe bump it to a fifty." If he wrote it, fifty is wrong, and if he didn't, fifty is wrong, so you're haggling over my son's mark. I'm writing that down for the principal.
Please, I'm trying here.
Trying isn't evidence. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
What would make you happy?
You're asking me to do your job for you. The zero withdrawn in writing today, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.
Then there's nothing under that zero but software and a feeling. Take it off today, or I walk down to the principal's office the minute my call ends.
I can get more by next week.

So the zero stays while you go looking for a reason for it. You punished first and you'll investigate second, and his scholarship applications close December 1. That's backwards, and it comes off until you have something.
Can we keep talking?
Two minutes. Is the zero coming off, yes or no?
Just a few more minutes.
My call is waiting, so you have one minute. The zero comes off in writing today with an apology to Owen, nothing goes on his record, or I'm in the principal's office tonight.
I hear you have a call.
I'm late for it, and I'm still waiting for your answer on the zero.
What time is it?
Past 4:40, and you still haven't said whether that zero is coming off.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Widely used doesn't make it evidence, and the zero comes off or I'm with the principal tonight.
I still think it's right.
Then you can explain "I still think" to the principal tonight, because I'm going straight there.
Okay.
If that okay means the zero comes off, I want it in an email tonight; if not, I'm walking to the principal's office now.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn in writing, that he receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing. She still wants the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated, checkable document from Owen's own work in front of her.
What cost ground: Offering to raise the mark to fifty with no evidence behind it, because it told her the zero was negotiable rather than based on anything.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your case never came close to that night, since you showed no times, dates or drafts. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and when, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, and then show her something dated from Owen's own work instead of the checker score.
